one_line: A provincial Satavāhana royal officer from the Deccan, managing ahāras and village grants in the 2nd century CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, medium height, lean but sturdy build with a light administrator’s physique rather than a warrior’s bulk.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-full lips, warm medium-brown complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, arched brows and sharp observant eyes; default expression is calm, focused and slightly stern with a hint of diplomatic warmth.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair oiled and pulled back into a compact low knot at the back of the head, wrapped with a narrow off-white cloth band like a modest headscarf that leaves the forehead clear, the band knotted behind the right ear with a short trailing end.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off-white cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders like a light shawl, edged with a thin maroon stripe, over a fitted, long-sleeved pale-cream cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh with a simple round neck; a deep indigo-blue cotton dhoti, pleated in front and wrapped to just above the ankles, is tied with a broad maroon waistband whose loose ends hang slightly to the left; his feet are in simple brown leather sandals with toe loops; jewellery is modest but elite: a single thin gold neck torque close to the collarbone, one small gold ring in each ear, and a plain gold ring on his right hand; he carries a small rectangular palm-leaf bundle tucked into his waistband and a narrow cloth pouch at his left hip, suggesting documents and seals.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf charter tied with a red cotton cord, with a small bronze seal dangling from the knot, usually held in his right hand or tucked under his arm.

ref_desc: Śivakhaṇḍila is a lean, medium-brown Satavāhana administrator with an oval face, trimmed beard, black hair in a low knot wrapped by an off-white band, wearing an off-white shawl, cream tunic, indigo dhoti, maroon sash, simple gold ornaments, brown sandals, and holding a rolled palm-leaf charter with a bronze seal.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Satavāhana-era Deccan administrator named Śivakhaṇḍila: a late-20s lean man with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp observant eyes, and black hair pulled into a compact low knot wrapped with a narrow off-white cloth band knotted behind his right ear. Show him in an off-white cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders like a light shawl with a thin maroon border, over a fitted long-sleeved pale-cream tunic reaching mid-thigh, and a deep indigo-blue cotton dhoti pleated in front and wrapped to just above the ankles, tied with a broad maroon waistband whose loose ends hang slightly to the left. Put simple brown leather sandals with toe loops on his feet, a thin gold neck torque close to his collarbone, small gold earrings, and a plain gold ring on his right hand; add a small rectangular palm-leaf bundle tucked into his waistband and a narrow cloth pouch at his left hip. His signature prop is a rolled palm-leaf charter tied with a red cotton cord from which a small bronze seal dangles, held in his right hand or tucked under his arm; keep the palette in off-white, cream, indigo blue, maroon, warm brown, and gold, and present him in neutral poses from multiple angles to emphasise this consistent hair, costume, and charter prop design.
